name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and an approved Awin Feed, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.8.5 adds one automatic broader API search when the first pass cannot fill verified cards, and verifies merchants before ranking. Commercial relationships never affect relevance or ranking. Every card has a stable selectionId. Authorized Chrome remains a bounded fallback after both API passes return no usable verified product. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
